paper.title: Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors

result.summary: 这篇论文研究的是如何减少大型前馈神经网络在小训练集上的过拟合问题 [p1]。作者提出在每次训练样本呈现时以 0.5 的概率随机丢弃一半的隐藏特征检测器，从而阻止特征检测器之间复杂的共适应 [p1][p3]。在 MNIST 上，使用 50% dropout 并配合每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束，可将标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果从 160 个测试错误降至约 130 个，再随机丢弃 20% 像素后进一步降至约 110 个 [p6]。在 TIMIT 上，dropout 将帧识别率从 22.7% 提升到 19.7%，创下不使用说话人身份信息方法的记录 [p9]。原文指出随机 dropout 在许多基准任务上带来大幅改进，并在语音和物体识别上创下新记录 [p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小训练集上训练时，通常在留出测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1]。原文指出，如果输入与正确输出之间的关系复杂且网络有足够多隐藏单元来精确建模，通常会有许多不同的权重设置能几乎完美地建模训练集，尤其当标注训练数据有限时；这些权重向量在留出测试数据上会做出不同预测，且几乎都会比在训练数据上更差，因为特征检测器被调谐为在训练数据上协同工作而非在测试数据上 [p2]。

evidence.quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.

If the relationship between the input and the correct output is complicated and the network has enough hidden units to model it accurately, there will typically be many different settings of the weights that can model the training set almost perfectly, especially if there is only a limited amount of labeled training data.

Each of these weight vectors will make different predictions on held-out test data and almost all of them will do worse on the test data than on the training data because the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.

method.text: 论文提出用“dropout”来减少过拟合，防止训练数据上的复杂共适应 [p3]。在每次呈现每个训练样本时，每个隐藏单元以 0.5 的概率被随机从网络中省略，因此隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。dropout 也可视为一种对神经网络进行模型平均的高效方式：随机 dropout 使得在合理时间内训练大量不同网络成为可能，这些网络共享被保留隐藏单元的相同权重 [p3]。

evidence.quote: Overfitting can be reduced by using “dropout” to prevent complex co-adaptations on the training data.
On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
Random dropout makes it possible to train a huge number of different networks in a reasonable time.
There is almost certainly a different network for each presentation of each training case but all of these networks share the same weights for the hidden units that are present.

experiments.text: 论文在 MNIST 上初步探索 dropout 的有效性，该数据集包含 60,000 张 28x28 手写数字训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像 [p6]。在 TIMIT 基准的核心测试集上，网络输入为 21 个相邻帧、每帧前进 10ms，网络有 4 个全连接隐藏层、每层 4000 个单元和 185 个 softmax 输出单元，随后合并为基准使用的 39 个不同类别 [p9]。对于语音识别数据集和两个物体识别数据集，作者通过留出单独的验证集来评估大量不同架构的性能，并选用在验证集上带 dropout 表现最好的架构来评估 dropout 在真实测试集上的性能 [p12]。

evidence.quote: We initially explored the effectiveness of dropout using MNIST, a widely used benchmark for machine learning algorithms.
It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
The input to the net is 21 adjacent frames with an advance of 10ms per frame.
The neural net has 4 fully-connected hidden layers of 4000 units per layer and 185 “softmax” output units that are subsequently merged into the 39 distinct classes used for the benchmark.

We made these decisions by holding out a separate validation set that was used to evaluate the performance of a large number of different architectures and we then used the architecture that performed best with dropout on the validation set to assess the performance of dropout on the real test set.

findings.text: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何增强或预训练技巧时，标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误；使用 50% dropout 并配合每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再随机丢弃 20% 的像素后进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。在 TIMIT 上，无 dropout 时识别率为 22.7%，有 dropout 时提升到 19.7%，这是不使用任何说话人身份信息方法的记录 [p9]。50% 隐藏单元 dropout 显著改善了多种不同网络架构的分类 [p9]。在 Reuters 上，带和不带 dropout 训练的两种网络均获得显著改进，学习不仅带来更好的泛化，而且进展平滑，无需早停 [A3.p4]。在 ImageNet 上，使用大量参数的非卷积高层在 dropout 下带来大幅改进，而没有 dropout 时则使情况变糟 [A8.p3]。

evidence.quote: Without using any of these tricks, the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.

This can be reduced to about 130 errors by using 50% dropout with separate L2 constraints on the incoming weights of each hidden unit and further reduced to about 110 errors by also dropping out a random 20% of the pixels (see figure 1).
Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
Dropout of 50% of the hidden units significantly improves classification for a variety of different network architectures (see figure 2).
As in all previous datasets discussed so far, we obtain significant improvements here too.
The learning not only results in better generalization, but also proceeds smoothly, without the need for early stopping.
This is clearly demonstrated by the fact that using non-convolutional higher layers with a lot of parameters leads to a big improvement with dropout but makes things worse without dropout.

limitations.text: 原文指出，卷积共享滤波器架构的一个后果是相对于所有神经元使用不同滤波器的神经网络大幅减少了参数数量，这降低了网络的表示能力，但也降低了过拟合的能力，因此 dropout 在卷积层中的优势远没有那么明显 [A6.p3]。

evidence.quote: This reduces the net’s representational capacity, but it also reduces its capacity to overfit, so dropout is far less advantageous in convolutional layers.
